dictionary_derivation: JSON array of PostProcess.character_dict in inference.yml, in original order, followed by one space as in PaddleOCR CTCDecoder. No user-photo text or substitutions.
preprocessing: BGR default; fixed height48, widthceil(48*w/h) capped3200, bilinear uint8 resize, float/127.5-1, NCHW. CTC blank0, collapse consecutive classes before removing blanks.

runtime_artifact.selection_reason: Pinned official release compatible with application minSdk23. The 1.21.1 AAR declares minSdk24. Both provide native RunOptions.setTerminate.

detection.preprocessing: Official model YAML: BGR; resize_long960,ceil128; /255 then mean[.485,.456,.406],std[.229,.224,.225]; NCHW
detection.postprocessing: DB binary threshold0.3,quad score0.6,unclip1.5; retain every accepted detection within bounded whole-page budget.

detection_v6_small.preprocessing: Official default: BGR; minside736,maxside4000,round32; /255 then mean[.485,.456,.406],std[.229,.224,.225]; NCHW
detection_v6_small.postprocessing: DB threshold0.2,quad score0.45,unclip1.4; 3000 contours; bounded full-page input, no truncation.
